  Description: "Arnor was once a great realm, formed by Elendil in the Second Age, however, by the dwindling years of the Third Age, Arnor had fallen into ruin; a shadow of its former glory. Yet in days gone by, even as it fell into despair, the Kings of Arnor would send out patrols of their warriors to protect the realm against the swarms of fell creatures under the Witch-king's command.\n\nThose who led these small patrols were warriors who were destined to command Arnor's armies, but did not yet possess the experience required to lead. They would set out from Fornost with their loyal companions to fend off the Orc raiding parties that threatened their home. These warbands were also used by the kings of old to explore the crumbling ruins that were once Arnor's cities, abandoned long ago, in search of heirlooms of their forebears."
  Start: [{Count: 4, Unit: "Warrior of Arnor"}, {Count: 3, Unit: "Ranger of Arnor"}]
  StartGold: 4
  HeroUpgrades:
    -
      Name: "Foresight of the Seer"
      Flavour: "It is the hero's sworn duty to protect the realm of Arnor, no matter the cost."
      Rule: "Foresight of the Seer"
      Text: "Whenever this Hero suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On the roll of a natural 6, the Wound is ignored. If this Hero would later gain a special rule with the same effect (e.g. Oblivious to Pain) then treat that special rule as improving Foresight of the Seer to a natural 5+."
  Rules:
    - "Should a Ranger of Arnor Warrior achieve a Hero in the Making result on the Warrior Promotion Table, they instead trade out their profile in its entirety for a Ranger of the North. They will retain their spear, if applicable, however they will not carry over their armour from the Ranger of Arnor profile."
  Oath:
    Text: "Heirs of Arnor, I take command of this company to keep the watch our kings began, and to carry the fury of the North against the servants of the Witch-king. From this day let us be called {name}. May that name bring dread to our foes and hope to our people."
    Vow: "I solemnly vow"

    Quote: "Leave all that can be spared behind. We travel light."
